privacy.notes: Metadata-only Stata interop binding contract. It describes file-import, CLI-invocation, DTA-exchange, and service-fallback request and response structs, diagnostics, provenance, errors, fixture gates, and module readiness without committing calculator logic, licensed payloads, or Stata formula ports.

public_calculator_contract.notes: The Stata interop request and response structs mirror the public calculator contract fields and only add transport metadata for file-import, CLI-invocation, DTA-exchange, and service-fallback handoff.

transport_modes.notes: Primary path for Stata users who import delimited CSV or Parquet output from the shared core.
Primary path for Stata users who invoke the shared-core CLI via shell or winexec.
Fallback path for Stata-native .dta workflow after CSV/Parquet import.
Fallback path for callers that need online request/response behavior when file or CLI paths are unavailable.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.notes: Binding schema version for the request envelope.

fields.name: calculator_id

fields.name: pricing_year

fields.name: output_schema_version

fields.name: csv_input_path

fields.name: csv_output_path
fields.notes: Local path for CSV output when the binding uses a file boundary.

fields.name: parquet_input_path
fields.notes: Local path for Parquet input when the binding uses a file boundary.

fields.name: parquet_output_path
fields.notes: Local path for Parquet output when the binding uses a file boundary.

fields.name: cli_command
fields.notes: The shell command string to invoke the shared-core CLI from Stata.

fields.name: service_url
fields.notes: Configured service endpoint for the fallback transport path.

fields.name: correlation_id
fields.notes: Traceable caller-provided request identifier.

fields.name: metadata
fields.notes: Opaque caller metadata that must not carry calculator logic.

fields.name: fixture_gate

fields.name: dta_output_path
fields.notes: Local path for .dta output when the binding uses DTA exchange.

request_structs.notes: Single versioned Stata interop request envelope that mirrors the public calculator contract and adds only transport metadata.

response_structs.name: StataInteropResponse

fields.name: schema_version
fields.notes: Binding schema version for the response envelope.

fields.name: calculator_id
fields.notes: Echoes the public calculator identifier.

fields.name: pricing_year
fields.notes: Echoes the pricing year used during execution.

fields.name: mode
fields.notes: Declares the transport path that produced the result.

fields.name: success
fields.notes: True only when the request completed without a blocking error.

fields.name: status
fields.notes: Machine-readable execution state for the caller.

fields.name: message
fields.notes: Short human-readable summary of the result.

fields.name: warnings
fields.notes: Non-blocking warnings attached to the response.

fields.name: errors
fields.notes: Machine-readable error records emitted when the response does not succeed.

fields.name: diagnostics
fields.notes: Structured diagnostic record with pass, fail, and blocked checks.

fields.name: provenance
fields.notes: Provenance record for the request and any generated artifact.

fields.name: csv_output_path
fields.notes: CSV output path used by the file boundary.

fields.name: parquet_output_path
fields.notes: Parquet output path used by the file boundary.

fields.name: dta_output_path
fields.notes: DTA output path used by the DTA exchange boundary.

fields.name: cli_stdout
fields.notes: Captured stdout from the CLI invocation.

fields.name: service_url
fields.notes: Service endpoint used to complete the request.

fields.name: fixture_gate_state
fields.notes: Observed fixture-gate outcome for the request.

fields.name: module_readiness_state
fields.notes: Observed Stata interop module readiness state for the binding bundle.

response_structs.notes: Single versioned Stata interop response envelope that captures success, diagnostics, provenance, and transport-specific outputs.

diagnostics.notes: The Stata interop request and response structs mirror the public calculator contract fields.
File-import and CLI-invocation are the primary transport boundaries for Stata.
DTA-exchange and service fallback are explicitly declared for native Stata and online workflows.
Fixture gates remain synthetic-only or local-only and do not expose restricted payloads.
Module readiness is tracked as declarative metadata rather than implied implementation status.

provenance.notes: Name of the contract or validation command that produced the artifact.
Stable identifier for the Stata interop binding contract bundle.
Path to the source manifest or fixture record used to derive the example.
Public source URL or local reference used for provenance.
Retrieval date in ISO-8601 date form.
Checksum algorithm used by the bundle.

errors.condition: request or response fields do not match the published Stata interop binding schema
errors.notes: Use this when the envelope is structurally invalid.

errors.condition: the fallback service boundary cannot be reached
errors.notes: The caller may retry or switch to a file or CLI boundary.

errors.condition: CLI execution fails from Stata shell or winexec
errors.notes: The failure is transport-level, not calculator logic.

errors.condition: CSV or Parquet file cannot be read by Stata
errors.notes: Use for file-boundary errors in file-import or DTA-exchange.

errors.condition: synthetic-only or local-only fixture gate is not satisfied
errors.notes: The request must stop before any restricted payload is handled.

errors.condition: the Stata adapter is unavailable or package promotion is deferred
errors.notes: Use this when local file/CLI transport is not available, or when a caller asks for SSC/package publication evidence that is not claimed.

fixture_gates.notes: Committed examples must stay synthetic and metadata only.
Any licensed payloads stay local-only and user-supplied outside the repository.
The binding must remain pinned to the public calculator contract field set.

module_readiness.notes: The mchs.ado adapter exposes bounded file-import, CLI-invocation, and column-validation commands without calculator logic.
The repository does not assert SSC or published Stata package readiness.
File-import and CLI-invocation paths are declared as primary batch and interactive paths.
DTA-exchange and service fallback boundaries are declared for native and online workflows.

rules: Keep all examples synthetic and metadata only.
Mirror the public calculator contract fields explicitly.
Do not duplicate calculator math, thresholds, or adjustment logic in the Stata binding.
Prefer file-import or CLI-invocation first and use DTA-exchange or service boundary when native or online behavior is needed.
Keep diagnostics, provenance, and errors explicit and machine readable.
Keep fixture gates local-only and user-supplied for any licensed assets.
Treat package publication readiness as declarative metadata until an actual Stata package is introduced.
